user_story.role: assistant acting on a person's contacts
user_story.capability: every list with its name and size
user_story.benefit: I can answer "what lists do I have?" and pick the right one

criteria.trigger: the list-reading tool is called
criteria.behavior: return every list in the default address book
give each list its id, its name and its member count
order lists by name, ignoring case and accents
count only members that are people in the address book, leaving missing references out of every count

criteria.trigger: the address book has no lists
criteria.behavior: return an empty result without an error

user_story.capability: the people in one list in the same pages as the rest of the address book
user_story.benefit: I can answer "who is in my Family list?" without reading everyone

criteria.trigger: the listing tool is given a list id
criteria.behavior: return only the people who are members of that list

criteria.trigger: the listing tool is given a list id
criteria.behavior: apply the same ordering, page size limits, cursors and field options as an unfiltered listing

criteria.trigger: the listing tool is given a list id
criteria.behavior: report as the total the number of members that are people in the address book

criteria.trigger: the given list id does not identify a list in the address book
criteria.behavior: reject the request with an error saying the list was not found

criteria.trigger: a cursor issued for another list or for the unfiltered listing is passed with a list id
criteria.behavior: return an error telling the caller to start again from the first page

criteria.trigger: the listing tool is called without a list id
criteria.behavior: return the same people, order and entries as before this feature

user_story.capability: to see which lists a person is in
user_story.benefit: I can answer "is Sam in my Work list?" from the person's record

criteria.behavior: include in each full contact read the lists the person is a member of, each with its id and name
order a person's lists by name, ignoring case and accents

criteria.trigger: a person is a member of no list
criteria.behavior: return an empty set of lists for that person

criteria.trigger: a request's field option names the person's lists
criteria.behavior: add them to each entry of the listing, search and upcoming-dates tools
state in the full-read tool's description that a person's lists are read-only there and are changed with the list tools

user_story.capability: to add people to a list and remove them
user_story.benefit: I can act on "add Sam to Work" or "take Jo off the party list"

criteria.trigger: the membership tool is called with people to add
criteria.behavior: make each of them a member of the list

criteria.trigger: the membership tool is called with people to remove
criteria.behavior: remove each of them from the list

criteria.trigger: a person to add is already a member, or a person to remove is not a member
criteria.behavior: leave that person's membership as it is and report the person as unchanged

criteria.trigger: a contact id to add or remove does not identify a person in the address book
criteria.behavior: reject the request without changing the list

criteria.trigger: one request both adds and removes the same person
criteria.behavior: reject the request without changing the list
keep every member entry that a request does not name, including missing references
keep every property of the list card that the request does not change, apart from the card's revision timestamp

criteria.trigger: a request would leave the list exactly as stored
criteria.behavior: send no write to iCloud

criteria.trigger: the list changes in iCloud between the read and the write of a membership change
criteria.behavior: apply the requested change to the newer version, keeping the other change

criteria.trigger: the list changes in iCloud again before that second write
criteria.behavior: return a conflict error without writing

criteria.trigger: a membership change completes
criteria.behavior: return the list's id, name and member count with the people added, removed and unchanged

user_story.capability: to create, rename and delete lists
user_story.benefit: I can organise the user's contacts the way Contacts on iPhone can

criteria.trigger: the create tool is called with a name
criteria.behavior: create a list with that name

criteria.trigger: people are given to the create tool
criteria.behavior: create the list with them as its members

criteria.trigger: the requested name is empty after trimming spaces
criteria.behavior: reject the request without writing

criteria.trigger: another list already has the requested name, ignoring case and accents
criteria.behavior: reject the create or rename without writing

criteria.trigger: the update tool is given a new name
criteria.behavior: rename the list and keep its members

criteria.trigger: the delete tool is called with a list id
criteria.behavior: delete that list
leave every person card unchanged when a list is created, changed or deleted

criteria.trigger: the id given to the update or delete tool identifies a card that is not a list
criteria.behavior: reject the request without changing any card

criteria.trigger: a list changes in iCloud between the read and the write of a rename or a delete
criteria.behavior: return a conflict error without writing
store a new list with the same card properties as a list created in Contacts on iPhone, so that it appears on the user's devices

criteria.trigger: a list is created or renamed
criteria.behavior: return its id, name and member count

user_story.role: person whose assistant manages my lists
user_story.capability: answers that match my phone and edits that touch only what I asked for
user_story.benefit: I can trust the assistant with my address book

criteria.trigger: a list tool or a list-filtered listing is called
criteria.behavior: answer from data checked against iCloud with the caller's credentials during that call

criteria.trigger: a list write succeeds
criteria.behavior: show the change in the next read for the same account

criteria.trigger: an account is warm
criteria.behavior: answer within 0.5 seconds of network and processing time

criteria.trigger: iCloud returns an error
criteria.behavior: return that error without sending any further write

criteria.trigger: an argument is malformed (a wrong type, an empty name, an id that is not an iCloud address, or an update with nothing to change)
criteria.behavior: reject the request before sending any request to iCloud
mark the list-reading tool as read-only, the create tool as a write, and the update and delete tools as destructive
keep the parameters and responses of every existing contact tool unchanged, apart from the optional list id on the listing tool and the lists of a person in contact reads

user_story.benefit: the assistant uses lists correctly without trial and error

criteria.behavior: state in their descriptions that list members are given and returned as contact ids
state in the delete tool's description that deleting a list keeps the people in it
describe every list tool and the list filter on the listing tool
